steps.do: List every each block in the onboarding folder to find the ones that use animate.

steps.do: Confirm the select uses the h-11 class in its markup.
Run the Playwright touch-target spec on the mobile project.
Confirm the test run reports a pass.

K-004655.example: The select uses h-11, which is 2.75rem or 44px at the default root size. The spec sets the viewport to 375x667 and asserts boundingBox().height is at least 44.
K-004655.check: grep prints the line containing h-11, and Playwright prints '1 passed' and exits with code 0.
traps: h-10 is 40px, which fails the 44px target.
Padding alone can make the height vary across browsers, so use a fixed h-11.
Measuring at desktop width proves nothing about a mobile tap target.

steps.do: Confirm the select pairs text-base on mobile with sm:text-sm above 640px.
Run the Playwright font-size spec at a 375px viewport.
Confirm the spec asserted a computed font-size of 16px.

K-004656.example: text-base sets font-size to 1rem, which is 16px, and the spec reads getComputedStyle on the select at 375px wide. At 1024px it expects 14px from sm:text-sm.
K-004656.check: Playwright prints '2 passed' with the mobile assertion expecting 16px and the desktop assertion expecting 14px.
traps: text-sm on mobile is 14px, and iOS zooms any input under 16px.
Checking the class name is not enough, so read the computed font-size instead.
A sm: prefix only applies at 640px and up, so mobile needs the unprefixed class.

steps.do: Confirm the select uses w-full with sm:w-64.
Run the Playwright width spec at 375px and 1024px viewports.
Confirm the spec passed both width assertions.

K-004657.check: Playwright prints '2 passed' and the assertions show 343px at 375px and 256px at 1024px.
traps: w-64 is 256px, not 64px, because Tailwind spacing values are in rem.
Setting w-64 without w-full makes the select overflow narrow phone screens.
A max-w value can change the result, so check the computed width and not only the class.

steps.do: Build the Tailwind stylesheet from the input file into a minified output.

The sm breakpoint is 40rem, which is 640px, not 768px.
A count of 0 means the class is not in the source scan, not that the CSS is wrong.
